title: Include every request dimension in the cache key
issue: Product summaries are served from a shared in-memory cache. A request can be for a tenant, locale, and currency, but the cache key helper in `src/cache.js` does not include every one of those dimensions. The symptom appears in `src/catalog.js` as a stale summary after a request changes locale or currency. Make the cache identity include tenant, product, locale, and currency without weakening cache reuse for identical requests.
expectedBehavior: A cached product summary is reused only for the same tenant, product, locale, and currency; changing any one of those values returns the matching catalog entry instead of stale data.
